tools.name: validate_ai_output
tools.description: Enterprise validation gate (IBM/ISO/MLOps, top-5% bar). Approves code or plans, flags performance/scalability/reliability/tech-debt issues (not syntax), and enforces deterministic anti-placeholder/anti-deception gates. Set validation_type='plan' to validate a plan.

tools.name: validate_plan
tools.description: Validate a PLAN/design BEFORE coding against enterprise standards: completeness, feasibility, performance & scalability implications, risks, ISO/MLOps compliance, and missing considerations.

tools.name: analyze_code
tools.description: Enterprise code analysis: performance/scalability hot paths, reliability, tech debt, and ISO/IEC 25010 + MLOps quality attributes (syntax/lint assumed handled upstream).

tools.name: generate_code
tools.description: Generate code with an LLM, then gate the result through the protection engine (no placeholder output)
